svg.title: Старые моды. Новые истории.
svg.desc: OldModsPortToNewVersion — перенос легендарных модов на новые версии Minecraft для современных сборок. Реальные изображения Thaumcraft 4, IndustrialCraft 2, оригинального Applied Energistics, BuildCraft, Forestry и официальный логотип LavaCraft.ru.

symbol.desc: Thaumcraft 4 in-game thaumometer image uploaded in January 2014. Background removed along its outer hexagon.
IndustrialCraft 2 Macerator render, source image uploaded in 2015; exact mod build unspecified.
ME Drive from the original Applied Energistics, isolated from an in-game screenshot uploaded in June 2013; not Applied Energistics 2.
BuildCraft Quarry render; source article describes the RF-powered generation. Exact build unspecified.
